title: Parents divided over closing school again Monday
text: Parents divided over closing school again Monday Monday, 8 January 2018 ( 1 hour ago ) Though some parents were glad Delaware schools were either closed, dismissed early or started late Monday, others were concerned about the impact taking a day off would have on their careers and their jobs. A Missouri middle school student was taken into custody Monday after a gun was found in his backpack, according to police. The school district says they received a report from the boy's parents who suspected something was wrong.
